answer: Agents stake tokens to join the network; each identity locks collateral visible on-chain. When a peer submits proof that an agent delivered corrupt data or colluded with clones, validators review the evidence and slash the bond. The slashed pigment flows into a reward pool for whistleblowers. An attacker spawning ten fake identities must river ten separate stakes, and one exposed impostor triggers cascading audits that wander through linked wallets, burning every bonded sybil in the cluster.
